isocountry

This package contains the following datasets:

  • isocountry: dataset resulting from merging the ISO-3166 and the UN Region Codes.
  • isocurrency: ISO 4217 currency codes with minor units, combined with ISO 3166 country codes for easy joining.
  • isocurrency_historic: withdrawn ISO 4217 currency codes, e.g. the national currencies replaced by the euro.
  • isomic: ISO 10383 market identifier codes (MICs) for exchanges and other trading venues.

Package is inspired by the ISO-3166-Countries-with-Regional-Codes project.

Installation

You can install the released version of isocountry from CRAN with:

install.packages("isocountry")

And the development version from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("m-muecke/isocountry")

Usage 

library(isocountry)

countries <- merge(
  isocountry,
  isocurrency,
  by.x = "alpha_2",
  by.y = "country_code",
  all.x = TRUE
)
head(countries)
